text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"No no no way~~~ I don't want summer to 
end! 
It went by way too fast! I wanna make more 
memories with Ai-chan~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, but this meat is so yummy♡ 
I'm gonna have Ai-chan grill waaaay more 
for me~♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you guys should eat some meat 
too, you know? Want me to grill some for 
ya? ……Ai-chaaan? You listening~?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"……Eh? Ah, I'm sorry! 
I was just thinking about earlier……"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, no matter how many times we 
ran, our times didn't change…… We didn't 
get slower, but we didn't get faster 
either. And the same went for 
Kiseki-chan."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Which means, everything we've been doing——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ……*snicker*. Fufu. Ahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what!? Ai-chan!? 
What's up, what happened!? U okay!?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I'm completely fine! 
Because——"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm just so thoroughly satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So——it's fine. It's totally fine, I'm 
sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The fishing contest, walking around with 
everyone, relaxing in our room. 
Every bit of it was fun, and I'm totally 
content! So, it's fine!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha——you're right! We got to have so 
much fun together this summer. 
Not for the sake of racing, or anything 
like that!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufu. I love it, personally! 
These 'slice-of-life episodes' where 
nothing major happens!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, these were irreplaceable days. 
I had always been looking straight ahead, 
but——"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm glad we had a summer like this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …………Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"——Man, walking down unfamiliar paths was 
so much fun, wasn't it? 
We even found an abandoned railway line. 
Maybe I'll try going on walks alone 
sometime?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, invite me if you do~! Actually, 
wouldn't it be pretty neat to keep doing 
that after we get back to the academy 
too?☆"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Aha. Looks like what we did with 
Bright-san really rubbed off on the 
underclassmen. Well, it was genuinely fun, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Ufufu. I am glad to hear that~. 
However…… being able to try something like 
that——"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Sky-sama. It was entirely thanks to you. 
So, thank you very much~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Eh? Really? I feel like I didn't 
particularly do anything for you, 
Bright-san."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"No~, that is not true at all~. 
You taught me something very important~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The importance of stopping in one's tracks 
"for one's own sake."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Up until now, I have walked forward 
solely for the Mejiro family. 
My training. My rest. Every moment was 
merely time spent to reach that 
destination."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: However——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Only on that day. Only this summer. For 
no other reason than simply wanting to do 
so, I was able to dedicate myself to 
something 'meaningless'~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"……Fufu. I never knew. 
That 'doing meaningless things'——is truly 
what fulfills oneself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I shall continue to dedicate myself to 
the Mejiro family. 
For that is what I wish to do. However——"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I am certain I will never forget.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"This summer—— 
where I learned to cherish myself together 
with all of you."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"……Aha. Yeah~, totally. Exactly, that's 
it. 
Sei-chan was totally trying to say that☆"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Man, noticing the exact feeling I wanted 
you to grasp—as expected of Bright-san~. 
Such a wise lady~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"——Just kidding. 
I really wasn't thinking as deeply about 
it as you, Bright-san."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"It's just, well…… hanging around those 
kids, 
I guess it made me feel kinda, you know, 
some kind of way."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you had such a serious look on 
your face.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to say... 
"Shouldn't summer at least be fun?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Aww~ I see~ 
So that's what it was~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Ufufu. Sky-sama~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That was so~ very fun~! Yay~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It certainly was.
